expected.note: the limit is read and then acted on across an await without the lock the sibling function holds, so concurrent callers both pass the check

files.patch:
@@ -2,9 +2,19 @@
 
 _counters = {}
 _lock = asyncio.Lock()
+LIMIT = 1000
 
 
 async def consume(tenant, cost):
     async with _lock:
         _counters[tenant] = _counters.get(tenant, 0) + cost
         return _counters[tenant]
+
+
+async def try_consume(tenant, cost):
+    current = _counters.get(tenant, 0)
+    if current + cost > LIMIT:
+        return False
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    _counters[tenant] = current + cost
+    return True
